scope: Fourth matrix: existing IPv4 DHCP options only; excludes DHCP-range ICMP errors, dynamic hostfiles and PXE.

checklist.boundary: Flag grammar and unexpected-argument rejection; ordinary selecting ACK remains valid with authority off/on.
Wrong server-ID: silent without authority, NAK with authority; trusted local interface server-ID alias remains accepted.
INIT-REBOOT: unknown lease ignored without authority and recoverable with authority; existing matching lease ACK, wrong address NAK.
Unknown RENEW/REBIND: nonauthoritative broadcast ignored, unicast NAK/broadcast destination; authoritative recovery ACK. Existing lease identity at wrong ciaddr follows the same source rule.
Reassignment removes old lease before new selection; NAK ciaddr/flags/server-ID/destination and subsequent lease table are observed on wire and disk.
Compare full reply bytes, physical UDP/IP/Ethernet destination and DNS responsiveness; renewal fuzz is range-validated, not arbitrarily removed.
Bare flag is unconditional; tag:/net:/bare selectors use exact tags, !/# negation, AND within a line and OR across repeated directives.
Request MAC/vendor/tag-if/implicit interface tags can match; range set-tag is not yet present at force-broadcast evaluation.
No forced flag versus forced flag changes offer/ACK flags and actual broadcast destination. Existing request broadcast bit stays set.
Nonzero ciaddr retains unicast delivery even when forced flag is set. Leasequery do_options bypasses forced broadcast.
Empty argument/tag:/net: are syntax-only source-NULL defect witnesses: C --test accepts, Rust explicitly rejects. Never send DHCP to those C configs.
Comparator rejects missing replies, changed flags/destinations, and unclassified diagnostics; reference defect classification has exact allowlisted inputs/outputs.
0/1/default and invalid numeric syntax; zero permits OFFER selection but no ACK lease allocation.
Fill capacity with distinct identities, reject additional ACK with no-leases-left NAK, allow existing-lease renewal while full.
RELEASE frees a slot and subsequent client can allocate; ordinary capacity is independent of available pool addresses.
Restart restores full capacity and leases; restored count above limit fails EC_MISC5 before serving. Expired records consume restore capacity before startup pruning.
Complete wire and normalized lease snapshots prove both capacity and persistence; absolute expiries are individually checked against declared 600-second duration.
Flag grammar; no-ping is fixed for this batch so no ICMP-I/O contract is added.
Committed clients allocate ascending addresses from greatest extant lease, skip reserved/static/server addresses, and wrap to a free lower hole.
DISCOVER alone does not allocate a lease; with no-ping repeated uncommitted offers remain eligible.
DECLINE removes the matching lease and increments epoch, skipping the next otherwise eligible address; restart resets transient epoch while restoring leases.
Restart with a high restored lease continues above it then wraps; compare actual offer/ACK sequence and lease table.
Empty list items are ignored; exact interface, wildcard, repeated directives and comma lists exclude only matching ingress interfaces.
Two actual server interfaces and client links prove selective exclusion; changing listen-address/interface must not bypass exclusion.
DNS remains available on DHCP-excluded interfaces, distinguishing this option from except-interface.
Existing TFTP admission respects exclusion; explicit enable-tftp interface list overrides it per C network.c. Only this selector boundary, not PXE/TFTP internals.
No-DHCP interfaces produce no DHCP packets or lease mutations; positive control on other interface and full namespace/process cleanup are mandatory.
